description: Tool registry for the wekyt hub. Agents discover tools by description. No tool belongs to an agent. Access is granted per role under least privilege in permissions.md.

tools.description: Read the contents of a file in the repository. Read only. Never modifies state.
tools.name: Read file

tools.description: Create or overwrite a file in the repository. Restricted by role: the architect writes only architecture documents, the dev writes only files listed in the approved architecture.
tools.name: Write file

tools.description: Search the codebase by text, symbol, or file pattern. Read only. Used to understand existing code before planning, building, or reviewing.
tools.name: Search code

tools.description: Run the test suite or a selected test file and return pass or fail with output. The objective gate for QA and the local check for the dev.
tools.name: Run tests

tools.description: Run the linter and return violations with file and line. A failing linter blocks the pull request.
tools.name: Run linter

tools.description: Run the static checker, including type checks and security checks, and return findings with file and line.
tools.name: Run checker

tools.description: Search the public web for documentation, API references, and known vulnerabilities. Read only. Never used to fetch secrets or private data.
tools.name: Web search

tools.description: Create a git branch for a task. Branch names follow the task id. Never switches to or modifies the main branch directly.
tools.name: Create branch

tools.description: Commit staged changes on the current branch with a clear message. Every fix for a QA or security finding references the finding id.
tools.name: Commit changes

tools.description: Push the current branch to the remote. Never pushes directly to the main branch.
tools.name: Push branch

tools.description: Open a pull request from a branch with a description, the changed files, and test evidence. QA is explicitly forbidden from using this tool even though it exists in the registry.
tools.name: Open pull request

tools.description: Merge an approved pull request into the main branch. Only the merge step of the orchestrator may use this tool, and only when architect, dev, QA with tests green, and security all agree.
tools.name: Merge pull request

tools.description: Revert a merged commit and restore the previous state automatically when a merge fails, post merge checks fail, or a regression is detected. Only the orchestrator may use this tool.
tools.name: Rollback

tools.description: Append an audit entry recording a decision, delegation, approval, rejection, merge, or rollback, with task id, actor, evidence, and timestamp. Every agent uses this tool. The log is append only.
tools.name: Audit log
